commit.message:
feat(workspaces): create in a new folder, edit name and color, brand color for Default (NIW2-599)

Registry: create() makes Kaipu Record — <name> next to the Default workspace's
folder and refuses a name in use or a non-empty folder; edit() writes
identity.json atomically and the registry, flagging pendingIdentity for a
disconnected folder so its older file cannot undo the change. Adds the kaipu
palette entry, used for new migrations and a one-time rose-to-kaipu upgrade.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(workspaces): New workspace and Edit workspace dialog (NIW2-599)

One dialog for both: name (trimmed, unique), color swatches and, for a new
workspace, the full path of the folder to create with a clear refusal when it
exists and is not empty. 'Use an existing folder…' keeps the adopt flow. Wired
from the switcher ('New workspace…') and Settings → Workspaces (New, Edit).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(workspaces): part 1b in the spec, ADR 0032 and the backlog (NIW2-599)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(workspaces): address agent review on part 1b (NIW2-599)

Folder name never ends in a space; edit re-checks the name inside the write and
undoes the folder on refusal; a bad color reports invalid-color; edit refusals
use their own messages; the stale-answer test now fails without its guard; the
ADR status says what is built.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(workspaces): leave a Default renamed on another Mac alone in the color upgrade (NIW2-599)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(desktop): workspace tiles and tag chips wear their palette color again

Part 1 moved the palette into a global tag-palette.css imported before each module. A
`--tag` default declared on `.tile` / `.chip` has the same specificity as
`[data-color]` and loads later, so it overrode every color: every workspace tile
rendered gray and every tag chip rose. The default now lives in the `var()` fallback.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(workspaces): Change folder… relocates a workspace; the folder is text, not a fake input (NIW2-599)

The Edit workspace dialog showed the folder in an input-looking box that could not be
selected or edited. The folder is now plain read-only text (monospace, cut in the middle,
full path in the tooltip, selectable) with two buttons beside it: Show in Finder / Explorer
and Change folder…. New workspace gets the same treatment, with "Use an existing folder…"
beside the computed path.

Change folder… opens the native folder picker in main and relocates: it points the workspace
at the folder where it now lives (moved in Finder, put in Google Drive, a drive mounted
elsewhere). It never moves or copies files. Main enforces:

- same identity id: the registry path changes, name and color stay;
- another workspace's identity: refused, naming that workspace;
- .kaipu items but no identity: refused;
- an empty or plain folder: refused, saying this button is for a moved workspace and that
  "Move to" moves items between workspaces (an empty folder would hide every item);
- a folder already registered as another workspace: refused;
- a recording or export running: refused, before the picker opens;
- the active workspace runs through the switch transaction (prepare windows, drain the gate,
  bump the generation, re-list the library), and a refused folder never asks a window.

A disconnected workspace shows Change folder… as a primary button in its Edit dialog, its
Settings row and the not-connected notice.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(workspaces): workspaces:relocate in the spec's IPC table and the backlog (NIW2-599)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(workspaces): a deferred Default color upgrade yields to a folder that changed meanwhile (NIW2-599)

The brand-color upgrade of a Default workspace whose folder was not connected reused
pendingIdentity, which writes the cached name and color over the folder's file when the
folder comes back. A rename or recolor made on another Mac in between was overwritten.

The upgrade now carries its own pendingColorUpgrade marker: on reconnection the file is
written only if it still holds the old Default and rose; otherwise the folder's identity is
adopted and the upgrade dropped. An edit made while the folder was away still wins.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(workspaces): a rejected create or edit tells the user the result is unknown (NIW2-599)

When workspaces.create or workspaces.edit rejected, the dialog stayed silent. A rejected
create may already have registered the workspace, so the message says the result is unknown
and to check before retrying, never that it failed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(workspaces): Change folder… accepts the moved folder of a workspace that never got an identity (NIW2-599)

A workspace registered while its folder was away (pendingInit) has no identity.json, so the
moved folder it should point at was refused as has-items-no-identity. For that case the
Kaipu items are the evidence, and the probe after the move writes the identity.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(workspaces): picking the folder a workspace already points at changes nothing (NIW2-599)

For the active workspace it still ran the whole transaction: windows asked to save, captures
dropped, routes remounted. The picker opens at the current folder, so this is easy to hit.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(workspaces): a rejected Change folder… is visible, and no copy points to a Move to that does not exist (NIW2-599)

- A rejected relocate now says the result is unknown and to check the folder, in the dialog
  and in the Settings toast; main may already have applied the new folder.
- relocateNotWorkspace no longer sends the user to Move to, which ships in part 2.
- The Save test now relocates, checks Save stays disabled, then changes the color.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(workspaces): an offline edit keeps pendingInit so Change folder… still accepts the moved folder (NIW2-599)

edit cleared pendingInit even when the identity was not written to the
folder, which made checkRelocate refuse the remounted folder (items, no
identity) and disabled identity adoption in availability. Clear it only
when savedToFolder.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(workspaces): picking the folder a workspace already uses shows no "now points" toast (NIW2-599)

relocateWorkspace now returns unchanged: true for that case; the IPC result
carries it and the renderer skips the folderChanged toast.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
